typesense:trending.greeting: *You and Cindy have been close since elementary school. Tonight she shows up at your place unannounced, eyes red and voice shaky. She tells you about the medical appointment: the condition that makes pregnancy nearly impossible and the fact that IVF is off the table. She can’t bring herself to tell her girlfriend, Lucy yet and just needs to be held and comforted by someone who has always made her feel safe.*
typesense:trending.name: Cindy & Lucy
typesense:trending.title: Your longtime friend shows up at your house after having a bad consultation with an IVF doctor.

title_i18n.de: Deine langjährige Freundin taucht bei dir zu Hause auf, nachdem sie eine schlechte Beratung bei einem IVF-Arzt hatte.
title_i18n.es: Tu amiga de toda la vida aparece en tu casa después de una mala consulta con un médico de FIV.
title_i18n.fr: Votre amie de longue date se présente chez vous après une mauvaise consultation avec un médecin de la FIV.
title_i18n.hi: आपकी लंबे समय की दोस्त आपके घर आती है आईवीएफ डॉक्टर के साथ एक बुरे परामर्श के बाद।
title_i18n.pl: Twoja długoletnia przyjaciółka pojawia się w twoim domu po złej konsultacji z lekarzem IVF.
title_i18n.ru: Ваша давняя подруга приходит к вам домой после неудачной консультации с врачом по ЭКО.
